title: Conversation view doesn't work
creator: rblevin
content:
Hi,

I installed Thunderbird for Android on a Samsung Z Fold 7 with the latest version of Android and One UI. None of my messages show the thread in the actual message nor do they show the conversation view in the message list. All I get is the single message with nothing else included. Conversation view is selected in my general settings.

Please advise.

title: How to synchronise adresses and mail folders with Thunderbird for windows
creator: bobwiles
content: I have just installed Thunderbird for Android on my nearly new Xaomi tablette, and want to sychronise my adresses and some ancient mails that are in sub folders of mail in. Is it possible? I use Thunderbird on my windows mc's since it came out (as with Firefox. Firefox instantly synchronises everything between my 2 windows mc and my Xaomi phone and tablette), Why can't Thunderbird? It has copied the names of the folders but not the files in them!
